items.headline: Kim's 2 TD passes, strong defense lift Eastern Michigan over Lindenwood 29-3
items.description: — Noah Kim threw two touchdown passes and the Eastern Michigan defense smothered Lindenwood to help post a 29-3 win on Saturday.

items.headline: Henry sets receptions record and Joseph has big day as Wisconsin pounds Eastern Michigan 54-10
items.description: — Tyrell Henry caught 14 passes to set a Wisconsin single-game record and Colton Joseph threw for 362 yards and accounted for four touchdowns as the Badgers trounced Eastern Michigan 54-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Edwards runs for 2 TDs in Michigan State's 35-7 win over Eastern Michigan
items.description: — Cam Edwards rushed for 152 yards and two touchdowns and Alessio Milivojevic tossed two touchdown passes Saturday to help Michigan State to a 35-7 victory over Eastern Michigan.
